name: Angelina Rocca
original_name: アンジェリナ・ロッカ
source: A girl from Blew, the Blue Capital. Angelina lives in an ophanage and works as a butcher. She aims to become a stage actress and auditioned for the role of Princess Cristina before, but she did not pass the audition. Later she was invited by Wakaba to stand on the stage in Moosgrun's theatre festival.
translation: A girl from Blew, the Blue Capital. Angelina lives in an ophanage and works as a butcher. She aims to become a stage actress and auditioned for the role of Princess Cristina before, but she did not pass the audition. Later she was invited by Wakaba to stand on the stage in Moosgrun's theatre festival.
